sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Out-of-Gauge (OOG) Heavy Industrial Project Cargo Logistics

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Common Law (U.S.-influenced) and customary law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (Amended 2003)
Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York, 1958)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2019, as amended; Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended; Financial Institutions Act 2011; RMI Criminal Code; UN Security Council sanctions implementing regulations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Consent and Acceptance Letter

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, and beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and the RMI Domestic Assets Freeze List. Enhanced due diligence is required where any shareholder or UBO is a Politically Exposed Person, a close associate, or a family member of a PEP, or where the counterparty is located in a high-risk jurisdiction. Screening must be completed prior to name clearance and re-run within 24 hours before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations – Corporate Name Reservation and Registration Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the statutory official language. All corporate names must be submitted in Latin/Roman script; foreign-language names must be transliterated into Roman characters. The name must be distinguishable from every existing RMI corporate name, reserved name, and foreign registered name as required by the Business Corporations Act. Names implying government patronage, false limited liability, or misleading business activity are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name may be appealed by filing a written administrative appeal with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations within 14 business days of the rejection notice. The appeal must include a legal memorandum demonstrating that the proposed name meets the distinctiveness and language standards of the Business Corporations Act. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may petition the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for judicial review. No extension of a name reservation is permissible after the 30-day validity window; a new application and fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual or mail-forwarding-only offices are not permissible as the statutory registered office. The registered office must be a physical street address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, typically the office of the licensed registered agent, where service of process may be accepted. Remote administrative arrangements do not satisfy this requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – estimated less than 5% annual probability for a non-resident low-risk project cargo logistics entity under ISIC 5229; however, the Registrar of Corporations and the Financial Intelligence Unit retain the statutory right to conduct unannounced inspections of registered agent records and beneficiary ownership filings.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee – standard authorized share capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (Business Corporations Act 1990, Part VII)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent annual fee – includes physical office, service of process, and governance filing
Notarization and apostille/certification bundle – five-document set
UBO, AML/KYC and sanctions screening professional fee
Courier, bank reference coordination, and contingency documentation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, 51 MIRC ch. 1, as amended (the 'BCA'); principal formation provisions include Section 3 (formation), Section 24 (incorporation), Section 25 (articles of incorporation), Section 31 (registered office and registered agent), Section 44 (directors) and Section 54 (officers); non-resident domestic corporation status is governed by the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation provisions of the BCA.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Registrar, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro; submissions accepted directly or through a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) together with the executed Consent of Registered Agent; official issuance evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement under the BCA. The corporation may issue shares for such consideration as the board of directors determines to be adequate; for bank onboarding purposes the subscribed capital must be consistent with the entity's solvency statement and AML/KYC documentation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the share subscription tendered by the incorporator is hereby accepted, and the Corporation issues its authorized common shares to the subscribers upon payment of the consideration recorded in the Share Register; RESOLVED FURTHER: that the registered office of the Corporation shall be maintained at the office of [Registered Agent], Majuro, Marshall Islands, and [Registered Agent] is appointed registered agent authorized to receive service of process; RESOLVED FURTHER: that [Name] be elected President and [Name] be elected Secretary/Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual meeting of shareholders, with authority to open bank accounts, engage professionals, and execute all instruments to effectuate the Corporation's business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Majuro (online or via registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search and reservation request against the corporate register. The proposed name must include a corporate suffix such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation, and must be distinguishable from all registered names. Reservation is made in the name of the intended incorporator.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as indistinguishable, promptly file an amended reservation with a distinguishing element or an alternative name; a formal objection must be submitted within 5 business days to the Registrar for review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and corporate counsel; notarization by a licensed notary where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation under BCA Section 25, stating the corporate name, registered agent and registered office in Majuro, authorized share capital (e.g., 50,000 common shares at US$0.01 par value), the purpose clause covering freight transportation support activities (ISIC 5229 / NAICS 488510), non-resident domestic corporation status election, and any permitted indemnification provisions. The incorporator executes the Articles; initial directors consent to serve.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the purpose clause or capital structure, file a certificate of amendment or restrict the purpose language; resubmit corrected Articles within 10 business days of the query notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Licensed Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent (Natural Person or Corporate Agent), Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a registered agent licensed under the BCA to maintain the registered office in Majuro. The agent must execute a formal Consent to Act as Registered Agent confirming the physical office address and acceptance of service of process duties.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws consent or ceases to be licensed, appoint a successor agent within 30 days and file the change with the Registrar; failure to do so may result in administrative dissolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed Articles of Incorporation, the Consent of Registered Agent, and remits the official filing fee of US$150. The Registrar reviews the Articles for compliance with the BCA, endorses the instrument, and files the record in the corporate register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for deficiency, the Registrar issues a correction notice with a 15-day cure period; timely corrected Articles are refiled without prejudice, while a rejected filing may require a fresh filing and fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Incorporation and Tax-Exempt Status Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations; Ministry of Finance (Income Tax Division), Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing juridical personality. For a non-resident domestic corporation conducting no business within the Republic of the Marshall Islands, submit the non-resident declaration and Articles to the Ministry of Finance to obtain written confirmation of exemption from Marshall Islands income tax, facilitating bank onboarding.
required_dossiers: Supporting board resolution confirming no Mauritian physical operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax-exemption confirmation is delayed, the corporate secretary formally requests the certificate under the non-resident provisions and may appeal to the Director of Income Tax with the Articles and declaration; interim reliance may be placed on the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and Adoption of First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial directors and incorporators (private corporate action; no registry filing required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting of the initial directors or obtain unanimous written consent. The board adopts the Bylaws, approves the share subscription, ratifies the appointment of the registered agent and officers, and approves the pro-forma First Board Resolution covering share issuance, registered office, and officer appointments.
required_dossiers: Minutes of organizational meeting or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any quorum or notice defect is cured by executing a unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting; corrected minutes are backdated only to the extent permitted by the BCA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening, Tax Identification Number, and Compliance Calendar Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank engaged by the corporation; corporate secretary; Ministry of Finance (Tax and Statistics Division)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the project multi-currency corporate bank account for milestone wire and letter-of-credit settlement, using the Certificate of Incorporation, the non-resident tax confirmation, and the First Board Resolution as KYC evidence. Obtain the Marshall Islands Taxpayer Identification Number (if required for banking or filings), register the annual franchise tax calendar, and establish the statutory records and AML/KYC file consistent with the low-risk standard.
required_dossiers: Passport and proof of address of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires enhanced due diligence, provide the non-resident tax exemption letter, a corporate structure chart, and bank references; if a TIN is not automatically issued, the secretary applies to the Ministry of Finance and obtains an acknowledgment receipt pending issuance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) Secretariat, Division of Commerce, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; Marshall Islands Ports Authority for any local cargo handling operations — an FIBL and port permit are not required for a non-resident offshore project-logistics coordination entity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License under the Foreign Investment Business Promotion Act 1995; an Out-of-Gauge Cargo Handling and Port Operation Permit from the Marshall Islands Ports Authority would be required only if the entity physically conducts stevedoring, marshaling, or heavy-haul movements within RMI territory.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for non-resident offshore coordination; a Full EIA Report and Environmental Registration under the RMI EPA Act 1984 would be triggered only upon establishment of an onshore storage yard, warehousing, or fuel-handling facility in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not engaged for an office-only non-resident structure; for any future physical operation, compliance thresholds include: zero untreated wastewater discharge to the Majuro lagoon, no fugitive VOC emissions absent bulk fuel storage, and solid waste handling per the RMI Environmental Protection Authority solid waste regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a non-resident coordination vehicle; if an on-island branch or marshaling yard is established, the following clearances become mandatory: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire and Civil Defense Department (NFPA 101 adopted), structural and load-bearing inspection by the Ministry of Infrastructure, and workplace occupational safety clearance under the RMI Occupational Health and Safety requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance & Administration (RMI Tax Portal: www.rmi-invest.com for entity licensing; customs administration via Marshall Islands Customs Service under the Ministry of Finance)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Business Corporation must first register with the RMI Registrar of Corporations to obtain a Certificate of Incorporation and corporate registration number. For the purpose of local tax identity, the entity must subsequently apply for a Business License from the Ministry of Finance & Administration / Revenue Division. There is no unified TIN under Marshall Islands law; the Business License number and CAGE/company registration number collectively serve as the statutory tax identifier for customs, social security, and tax filings. Foreign entities may file online through the Registrar, appoint a registered agent in the RMI, and satisfy any minimum registered-office requirement. No minimum capital is required. Non-resident ownership is allowed without restriction.

stage_3.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Marshall Islands domestic tax law. The jurisdiction imposes no corporate income tax on non-resident Business Corporations; thus there is no entity-level pass-through election, no hybrid-mismatch election, and no income tax classification mechanism. Foreign status of the entity is established through non-resident ownership and registration as a non-resident corporation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Import Duty and Excise Tax Regime (No VAT or GST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable under the VAT/GST framework; no value-added tax registration threshold exists. A business license is required for any commercial activity regardless of turnover. For customs purposes, importers are required to be registered with the Marshall Islands Customs Service for clearance of equipment and project cargo.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate is currently in force in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Customs declarations are processed through the customs administration on standard commercial documents, with no mandatory e-invoicing integration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable because the Marshall Islands does not levy VAT or GST on exports. There is therefore no zero-rating mechanism for export of goods or offshore services. The indirect tax system is limited to import duties and excise taxes applied at the point of entry into the territory. Re-export of goods that were previously imported under duty-bond or temporary-import arrangements may qualify for draw-back or by-bond relief under customs rules, but such relief is a duty remission rather than a VAT zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (outward cargo manifest clearance)
Bill of Lading or equivalent multimodal transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or payment/milestone settlement evidence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: For any customs duty draw-back or temporary-export relief claimed on project cargo and heavy haul equipment, the Marshall Islands Customs Service may conduct post-clearance audits requiring proof of actual export, cargo arrival at destination, and inward remittance. False declarations, overstatement of duty relief, or failure to satisfy export documentation may result in immediate duty clawback, monetary fines of up to the value of the goods, suspension of the business license, and potential criminal liability under the RMI Customs Code. There is no VAT clawback because no VAT is imposed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (CBRMI)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no independent central bank conducting traditional monetary policy; the US dollar is the sole legal tender. The Central Bank of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (CBRMI) was established as the national financial supervisory authority. Regarding convertibility, both capital and current account transactions are fully liberalized. There is no separate exchange control act, no surrender or repatriation requirement, and profit remittance is untrammeled. Dividends, royalties, interest, and liquidation proceeds payable by an RMI Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders may be freely remitted in US dollars without central bank authorization. The only hurdle is the US dollar clearing constraint, whereby the RMI uses the US Federal Reserve wire system for cross-border settlement, meaning any sanctioned counterparty or OFAC-prohibited transaction can be blocked by US correspondent banks. For the target OOG project cargo logistics entity, the key practical limitation is not a domestic exchange control restriction but the extraterritorial reach of US sanctions and AML/CTF legislation, requiring enhanced counterparty screening for cargo destined to high-risk jurisdictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory surrender rules or mandatory conversion percentages for export receipts in the Marshall Islands. The RMI does not mandate repatriation of export proceeds, does not impose any timeline for collection, and does not require conversion of foreign-currency earnings into local currency. Because the US dollar is legal tender, exports are naturally invoiced and settled primarily in USD. If a project cargo logistics company receives proceeds through an RMI corporate bank account, the funds may remain in that USD account indefinitely or be transferred abroad without reporting or approval. Nonetheless, under the RMI Banking Act and the CBRMI supervisory framework, domestic banks must file suspicious transaction reports and maintain records of any transaction exceeding the threshold set by the bank's AML/CFT compliance program, but no foreign exchange surrender certificate or BOP report is mandated.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-to-Low. Offshore digital EMI solutions may provide non-resident USD IBAN and SWIFT routing for operational disbursements, but the RMI does not have a local passporting regime under PSD2. EMI incorporation in another jurisdiction such as Lithuania, the United Kingdom, or Singapore, or a US state-chartered non-bank money transmitter, is not a licensed Marshall Islands bank, and cannot hold an RMI corporate account as a depository institution. An RMI Business Corporation may open a treasury management account with an EMI for outbound disbursements, but the compliance team must assess whether the EMI is subject to US correspondent banking restrictions. Because the RMI is not a member of the EEA and lacks financial services passporting, settlement of large milestone wires with heavy-haul logistics counterparties should be executed primarily through a full-service US correspondent bank to avoid aggregate transaction limits and indiscriminate account freezing. The recommended architecture is a tiered liquidity structure: Bank of Guam for capital escrow, Bank of Marshall Islands for local operating expenses, and a non-US EMI only for small satellite vendor payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not statutorily required but is de facto necessary for a newly formed non-resident Business Corporation. The Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam follow US-style KYC/AML policies. For corporate account opening, the directors and ultimate beneficial owners must provide certified copies of passport, proof of address, or valid residence permit. In practice, both banks require at least one signing director or an authorized representative to attend an onboarding interview in Majuro or Ebeye; remote opening may be accepted after a video call, but the bank's compliance officer must affirmatively approve. To guarantee onboarding viability, we recommend physical attendance by either the company's natural-person director or a duly authorized corporate services officer equipped with notarized resolutions and apostilled powers of attorney. The strict documentary mandate includes a certified true copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, Articles of Incorporation, Corporate Bylaws, Certificate of Good Standing, Directors'/Secretary's Register, and the current Statement of Beneficial Ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-licensed logistics entity handling third-party freight payments with no prior corporate bank footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statement of business purpose, charter-party and service contracts, project cargo tender award, bank reference letter from a top-tier international bank, audited or reviewed financial statements, corporate ownership chart, CVs of directors and UBOs, and a detailed payment-flow matrix demonstrating that funds are disbursed only to statutory sellers of vessels or equipment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction exposure in project cargo route (e.g., counterparties domiciled in sanctioned or embargoed states)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ICD / UN Sanctions screening report, OFAC SDN list screening, shipment-route declaration with UN sanctions compliance mapping, loading/discharging port schedules, end-user certificates, and a compliance undertaking letter from the logistics company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Significant share capital injection from an offshore entity or non-regulated trust
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legalization and apostilled corporate documents of the transferor, source-of-wealth declaration, bank reference, prior-year audited financial statements, tax residence certificate, and a sworn UBO declaration with chain-of-title instruments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections may be routed through a correspondent bank wire in US dollars. The typical compliant protocol is a SWIFT MT103 transfer from the ultimate beneficial owner's or parent company's account to the RMI entity's account at Bank of Guam or Bank of Marshall Islands. The remittance must specify: purpose of remittance as 'Capital Contribution / Paid-In Capital', a detailed beneficiary account reference to the RMI Business Corporation ledger entry, and the reason code 'CAPT' or 'CURB' supported by a corporate resolution approving the capital increase. In practice, US dollar wire transfers to RMI banks are cleared through the US Federal Reserve system; therefore the corporate resolution and an internal capital-payment authorization should be retained in the compliance file to answer any request for information from the receiving bank. For transactions above the CBRMI threshold, no central reporting is mandatory, but banks apply FATF Recommendation 16 travel rule and record the originator and beneficiary information. The bank must not process an inbound transfer if the remitter is on any sanctioned list; thus the entity must provide an updated shareholder and ultimate beneficial ownership disclosure before the inbound transfer is requested.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The standard clearing rail for high-value trade disbursements is the SWIFT MT103 direct wire. For milestone payments to sub-contractors, carriers, stevedores, and heavy-lift equipment owners, the MT103 provides same-day federal wire finality if both banks are within the US clearing system. For large project cargo milestone settlements under enforceable contracts, a commercial Letter of Credit (proceeds payable by a downstream issuing bank) is the second-tier rail. This is especially compliant when the RMI entity is the LC beneficiary or when it issues deferred payment instructions under the LC. Use of a Documentary Collection (D/P or D/A) is possible but operationally inferior for high-value heavy-haul corridors. For trade settlements involving non-US counterparties, the MT103 should include structured purpose codes such as USTP (settlement of trade) or depending on underlying contract COST. The bank may also require a copy of the commercial invoice, bill of lading, and the specific milestone certificate to ensure the disbursement qualifies as a current account trade payment under the RMI's free-exchange system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD-denominated deposits require no FX hedging because the RMI uses the US dollar domestically.
Forward contracts in FDIC-regulated or US state-chartered banking counterparties for major currencies (EUR, GBP, CNY, AUD) where project costs are invoiced in a non-USD currency.
Cross-currency swaps with a US or European bank counterparty to monetize a rolled-up project cargo charter hire in USD.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are permissible only when transacted through a licensed US or foreign bank with a legal opinion confirming no US financial sanctions violation; such NDFs provide economic hedge for transportation-related currencies that are non-convertible.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation (annual return of registered office, registered agent, directors, officers, authorized and issued shares, plus annual government fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before November 30 of each calendar year; corporations incorporated after July 1 file their first annual report on or before November 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of USD 100 for filings received after November 30 but on or before December 31; penalty of USD 250 for filings received after December 31. Failure to file for two consecutive years permits the Registrar to certify the delinquency to the Attorney General and initiate involuntary administrative dissolution; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, reinstatement fees, and confirmation of a licensed registered agent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register and Annual UBO Confirmation Declaration (FATF-aligned beneficial ownership information submitted in conjunction with the annual report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed via the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the annual report due November 30; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must also be reported within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain, submit, or update beneficial ownership particulars is an offense under the Business Corporations Act; the corporation and each responsible officer may be subject to fines of up to USD 10,000 per violation. Deficient UBO records cause the Registrar to reject the annual report, thereby triggering late-report penalties and, ultimately, administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Licensed Registered Agent Continuation (ongoing maintenance of the required Marshall Islands statutory seat and agent appointment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous requirement; annual renewal with the licensed registered agent and immediate filing of any change of agent or registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Resignation of the registered agent without the appointment of a successor is a ground for dissolution by the Registrar; failure to maintain a registered office and licensed agent at any time results in loss of good standing, restriction on filing effectiveness, and administrative dissolution after notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. A mandatory independent audit arises only for a corporation whose securities are listed or publicly traded, a regulated financial institution (banking, insurance, or trust business), or an entity directed by the Registrar or by order of the High Court. ISIC 5229 out-of-gauge project cargo logistics is outside these categories; no statutory audit trigger exists for this entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Marshall Islands prescribes no domestic general-purpose accounting framework for non-resident Business Corporations. Directors must present a balance sheet and income statement to shareholders at the annual meeting; IFRS or US GAAP is the accepted de facto framework for non-resident companies. Financial statements are not required to be filed with the Registrar unless specifically requested.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Business Corporations Act beneficial-ownership regime, each Business Corporation must maintain a current beneficial ownership register and confirm or refresh its contents with the annual report due November 30. The licensed registered agent must collect and verify UBO particulars, and any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be reported to the agent and to the Registrar within 30 days of the change.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – 950 per year depending on the licensed Marshall Islands corporate services and registered agent provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary compilation or review engagement USD 3,000 – 8,000; full independent audit USD 10,000 – 25,000 when requested by lenders, insurers, or project counterparties

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident Business Corporations classified under the RMI Business Corporations Act are wholly exempt from Marshall Islands income tax on all non-domestic source income. No capital gains tax, branch profits tax, or gross receipts tax applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for a non-resident Business Corporation. The only recurrent filing is the Annual Corporate Registration Statement submitted to the RMI Registrar of Corporations through the official corporate registry portal (Corporate and Trademark Registry System).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment of the flat annual franchise tax are due on the anniversary of incorporation date. Failure to file by the due date triggers late fees and risk of administrative dissolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A – Corporate Name and Registered Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered corporate name and assigned entity registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm name matches the Certificate of Incorporation. No tax schedule or income disclosures are required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B – Registered Agent in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical address of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must maintain a physical office in Majuro; a non-resident BC may not act as its own agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names and residential addresses of all directors and officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: RMI law does not mandate director residency. Non-resident directors should list their usual foreign address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares and par value.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the share structure as per the articles of incorporation. No minimum capital requirement exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the primary business operations, if not the registered agent's address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a project cargo heavy-haul logistics company, the principal office may be outside RMI; no RMI-source operations should be listed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a monthly late penalty of USD 20 per month (subject to published fee schedules), loss of good standing certification, and involuntary dissolution upon continued noncompliance. Directors may be personally exposed to reinstatement costs and foreign civil claims after deregistration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No Marshall Islands withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a non-resident BC to its shareholders. Accordingly, no treaty relief application or Tax Residence Certificate is required for RMI-source dividends. If the shareholder seeks relief from U.S. source withholding under the U.S.–RMI Tax Treaty, the shareholder must submit U.S. IRS Form 6166 (Certificate of U.S. Residency) or RMI Tax Office attestation, and the paying U.S. entity must receive a valid W-8BEN-E before the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI withholding on royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 0% for a non-resident BC without local activity. If the BC earns U.S. source royalty or interest, U.S. withholding of 30% applies absent treaty reduction; the U.S.–RMI Treaty provides for 0% U.S. withholding on certain royalties and 15% on portfolio interest, subject to Form W-8BEN-E and Form 8833 disclosure.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold applies in the Marshall Islands; RMI has not enacted transfer pricing rules or country-by-country reporting obligations. Non-resident BCs are not required to prepare Local Folder or Master File.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands does not administer an Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to Barbados. The 0% tax status is available only to non-resident domestic corporations that do not carry on trade or business in RMI and are managed and controlled outside the Republic. For an OOG/heavy haul project logistics entity, the BC must maintain board minutes and contracts executed offshore, and must avoid RMI ports, crew sign-on, or revenue sourced from RMI waters; otherwise the RMI Income Tax Act may deem the company resident and expose 3% corporate income tax on RMI-source income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Misrepresentation of Non-Resident Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing RMI tax exemption while actually operating in the Marshall Islands through a local fixed base, booking RMI-sourced project freight revenue, or declaring income derived from RMI waters to foreign revenue authorities without reporting to RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Income Tax Act, misrepresentation may result in immediate assessment of 3% corporate tax on undeclared RMI-source income, plus an interest charge of 1% per month and a negligence penalty of 50% of the understated tax. Criminal referral to the RMI Attorney General for willful evasion can impose fines up to USD 10,000 per offense.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil for fraud or sham arrangements. Directors who signed false declarations are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes, restitution, and civil damages; a director may receive a foreign travel ban and up to two years imprisonment under RMI criminal tax provisions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Annual Franchise Tax and Registration Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the annual corporate report or pay the flat annual fee for two consecutive years, or failure to maintain a licensed RMI registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar will mark the corporation as delinquent, impose late penalties, and after further noncompliance administratively dissolve the company. A dissolved BC has no legal capacity to execute contracts, open bank accounts, or own litigation rights.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue to transact business after administrative dissolution are personally liable for all debts, and the corporate veil is automatically pierced. Directors may face criminal charges for operating an unregistered entity and restitution to harmed counterparties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file beneficial ownership particulars with the RMI Competent Authority, or laundering project cargo payments through shell companies to avoid UBO disclosure and foreign tax enforcement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting the Financing of Terrorism Act and Beneficial Ownership Regulations, penalties range from USD 5,000 to USD 100,000 per violation, plus revocation of the corporate license and freezing of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held criminally liable up to five years imprisonment for money laundering predicates. Civil forfeiture of all laundered proceeds may be enforced against the company and, upon showing of fraudulent transfers, against directors' personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Foreign Tax Residency Abuse (Shell Company Determination)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating an RMI BC with no commercial substance or management in the RMI solely to avoid the foreign home country's controlled foreign company, transfer pricing, or general anti-avoidance rules for an ISIC 5229 heavy-haul project cargo venture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign jurisdictions may void the RMI entity's separate status, reattributing all project cargo profits to the ultimate parent and imposing back taxes plus substantial penalties of 100% to 200% of avoided tax. RMI itself will not protect the entity under its non-resident exemption if it is not managed and controlled outside RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the holding company may be assessed for wrongful trading and subject to personal tax equal to 100% of the tax shortfall, travel restrictions, extradition, and imprisonment under foreign CFC rules when the RMI structure is a pure wrapper with no logistics substance at any operating level.
